│         │ enter/f     focus view         — Move the keyboard to the right side                             │         │
│         │ n           new session        — Start a new session from a plan or a branch                     │         │
│         │ o           one-off session    — Start a one-off session with no plan                            │         │
│         │ p           switch project     — Switch to another project                                       │         │
│         │ c           clean session      — Clean the selected session and its worktree                     │         │
│         │ r           restart agent      — only a stopped or stuck agent can be restarted                  │         │
│         │ l           edit label         — Give the selected session a display label                       │         │
│         │ /           filter sessions    — Filter the session list by name                                 │         │
│         │ esc         clear filter       — no filter is applied                                            │         │
│         │ :           command palette    — Open the command palette                                        │         │
│         │ b           build tasks        — this project has no build                                       │         │
│         │ i           inbox              — the inbox has not been read yet                                 │         │
│         │ P           pause the build    — this project has no build                                       │         │
│         │ U           resume the build   — this project has no build                                       │         │
│         │ ctrl+\      close pane         — no agent pane is open                                           │         │
│         │ ctrl+g      release mouse      — Let the terminal select text, or take the mouse back            │         │
│         │ q           quit               — Leave the dashboard; every session keeps running                │         │
│         │ ctrl+w      resize panes       — Move the divider between the list and the right side            │         │
│         │ esc/ctrl+\  back to list       — the session list already has the keyboard                       │         │
│         │ ctrl+t      agent or overview  — focus the right side first (enter)                              │         │
